newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Stadshypotek board to discuss bid Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Stadshypotek board to discuss bid Tuesday.

text.p: The board of Swedish mortgage bank Stadshypotek will discuss banking group Handelsbanken's bid for the group at its Tuesday meeting, Stadshypotek chairman Gosta Renell said on Monday.
It is, however, not clear if the board will form an opinion about the bid on Tuesday, Renell told Reuters.
"We will have the board meeting tomorrow and then we will of course discuss the issue," he said.
"But I do not know how far we will get," he said.
On Monday, the two groups' managements will continue their informative talks, which started on Friday, Renell said.
"Some information will be available for Stadshypotek today (on Monday)," Renell said, adding that he hoped that all necessary information will be at hand at Tuesday's board meeting.
Handelsbanken launched its 22.9 billion crown takeover bid on Thursday last week. The state, which is the single largest Stadshypotek owner with a 34 percent stake, accepted the bid.
On November 25, the boards of Stadshypotek and Swedish insurer Skandia proposed a merger between the two groups.
